description: This file declares an interface MerchantStoreDao, which extends a generic DAO interface. It specifies methods for retrieving merchant store data and associated products, likely used for database interactions within the merchant module of the sales manager application.

classes.name: MerchantStoreDao
classes.description: An interface extending a generic DAO, providing methods specific to merchant store entities, including retrieval of products and store details by ID or code.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of products associated with a given merchant store, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Fetches merchant store details by store ID.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Fetches merchant store details by store code, may throw a ServiceException.
